belief: The 5 oldest continuously operating German universities are: Heidelberg (1386), Cologne (1388), Leipzig (1409), Rostock (1419), and Greifswald (1456)

author: worker_1
belief: Prof. Dr. Frauke Melchior became Rector of Heidelberg University on October 1, 2023, succeeding Prof. Dr. Bernhard Eitel

author: worker_2
belief: Eva Inés Obergfell was the rector of Leipzig University as of November 20, 2023 (she took office on April 1, 2022)

author: worker_3
belief: Elizabeth Prommer was the rector of Rostock University as of November 20, 2023 (she took office on October 1, 2023, succeeding Wolfgang Schareck)

author: worker_4
belief: Katharina Riedel was the Rector of the University of Greifswald as of November 20, 2023 (she took office in April 2021)
